idea-plugin.name: Claude Panel
idea-plugin.description:
A docked tool window that runs the Claude Code CLI as a background process and renders the conversation natively — no terminal emulator, no TUI.

Unofficial, third-party plugin. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Anthropic. Anthropic publishes its own JetBrains plugin separately.

  • Sessions in a dropdown — picking one resumes it, and its transcript comes back
  • Tool calls as a single line each, coloured by outcome, without walls of file content
  • Permission requests answered in place: Allow and Deny sit right below the call
  • Interrupt a running answer without ending the session
  • Permission mode and model remembered per project; usage shown as a ring

Requirements: the claude CLI on your PATH and a Claude subscription. The plugin starts the CLI and never handles your credentials — signing in stays inside the CLI itself.
